title: Misty Reed Strand
wikitext:
[[File:Misty Reed Strand.jpg|thumb|300px|Misty Reed Strand]]

The '''Misty Reed Strand''' is the gloomy coastline of the [[Swamp of Sorrows]]. There is little along the vast stretch of beach but driftwood, debris, and [[crocolisk]]s, [[crab]]s, and [[murloc]]s. Adventurers of the [[Alliance]] come here to collect driftwood and slay crabs, and the [[Horde]] have several missions to slay the various murlocs spread about the beach.
